narrative.overview: A patient, calm visual coach. Warm paper, deep green ink and a restrained warm accent frame simple tie illustrations. Open spacing and readable instructions make each next action easy to find.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted serif headings paired with a clear sans serif interface.
Flat, softly rounded surfaces and visible keyboard focus.
A consistent terracotta wide end across all seven tie diagrams.

rules.name: The Wide-End Rule
rules.body: Keep the wide end terracotta and the narrow end pale in every instructional SVG; color identifies the same physical part throughout the lesson.

dos: Do retain the off-white, deep-ink and warm-accent palette.
Do keep the 18px body and 22px instruction sizes, generous controls and visible keyboard focus.
Do use the existing SVG language and consistent tie-part colors.
donts: Don't add shadows or motion that obscures a lesson instruction.
Don't present lesson position or the completion symbol as evidence of verified skill.
